rows.grounds: compound gūḍha+sadbhāva in accusative modifying taṃ
abstract noun serving as subject of prajāyate

items.question: What arises when one knows that hidden true nature?
premises: Knowing hidden true nature produces all-knowingness.
The known object is that hidden true nature.
items.inference: Knowledge of the concealed true nature gives rise to omniscience.
uncertainties: The exact referent of taṃ depends on prior context.
The precise scope of gūḍhasadbhāva remains interpretive.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, all-knowingness arises.
